mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers a surge in consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 5.0 in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross below 5.0 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in demand (GDPC1) and downward movement in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS falls in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction does not occur or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPI inflation index below 213.7 signals Fed tightening, reducing policy uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during a late-cycle expansion.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 213.7 in the next month
failure_condition: Not in a late-cycle expansion regime or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects robust supply-side growth, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not trend upward or 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in labor demand (PAYEMS) below 137,000 signals weakening employment momentum, leading to reduced corporate investment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 137,000 in the next month
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not fall below 137,000 or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward movements in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicate balanced growth, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise in the next month
failure_condition: The proxies do not both rise or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in RSAFS below 378,148 signals stabilizing demand, reducing short-term volatility and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during a post-shock recovery period.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below 378,148 in the next month
failure_condition: Not in a post-shock recovery regime or RSAFS does not fall below 378,148 or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
